DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 後ろをご覧になりながら歩くと、前の方にぶつかりそうですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: If you walk while looking behind you, you could bump into someone ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手袋を落としたのですが、散歩の記録を止めたくなくて、歩きながら振り返っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手袋を落としたが連続記録を守ろうと振り返り歩きしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I dropped a glove, but I did not want to stop my walk recording, so I was looking back while walking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you dropped a glove and walked looking back to preserve your uninterrupted recording. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記録より先に、周りを確認して立ち止まりましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before worrying about the recording, check your surroundings and stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 止まります。歩き続けないと今日の記録が途切れると思い、手袋だけ見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記録へのこだわりで前を見ていなかったと認め立ち止まる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will stop. I thought today's recording would be interrupted unless I kept walking, so I was only looking at the glove.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Admit that your fixation on the recording kept you from looking ahead, and stop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 落とした物は、場所を確かめてから取りに戻ってください。記録のために急ぐ必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check where the dropped item is before going back for it. You do not need to hurry for the recording.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベンチの手前に見えます。いったんアプリを止め、通る方を見てから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手袋の位置を確かめアプリを止め通行者を確認して戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can see it just before the bench. I will pause the app, check for people passing, and then go back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Locate the glove, pause the app, check for passersby, and go back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拾った後も、歩き始める前に前方を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: After picking it up, check ahead before starting to walk again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手袋を拾えました。携帯を操作する間は、この通路の脇で止まっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拾得後の携帯操作を歩きながら行わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I picked up the glove. I am standing at the side of this path while using my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not operate your phone while walking after retrieving the glove. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 周りの方が通れる幅も空けてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please leave enough room for other people to pass, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 幅を空けました。記録が途切れても、拾う時と携帯を触る時は止まり、しまってから散歩を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空け記録より立止りと周囲確認を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have left room. Even if the recording is interrupted, I will stop when picking things up or using my phone, put it away, and then continue my walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave the path clear and prioritize stopping and checking your surroundings over the recording. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。それでは、周囲に気をつけて散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Enjoy your walk, and stay aware of your surroundings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物のひもが、後ろの方に当たっています。少しご確認いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The strap on your luggage is hitting the person behind you. Could you check it, please?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。背中の荷物なので見えていませんでした。私が一歩前へ出ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 背中のひもが他客に当たり体を前へ出せばよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry. I could not see it because the bag is on my back. Would stepping forward be enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether moving your body forward will solve the strap on your back hitting another passenger. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前へ出るだけでは、ひもが揺れることがあります。周囲を見てから荷物を下ろしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Simply stepping forward may still leave the strap swinging. Check your surroundings before taking the bag off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここで急に振り向かず、列の脇で下ろします。長いひもをまとめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 急な振向きを避け列の脇で荷物を下ろしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will avoid suddenly turning around here and put it down beside the queue. I would like to gather up the long strap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to avoid turning suddenly and set your bag down beside the queue. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらなら列の通行を妨げずに確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check it here without obstructing people moving along the queue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらへ移りました。荷物の横に付けたひもが外れていたので、短く留め直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外れたひもを短くまとめ直したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have moved here. The strap attached to the side of the bag had come loose, so I will fasten it again to make it shorter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that you have gathered and shortened the loose strap again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 留め直した後も、持ち上げるときは近くの方に当たらないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even after fastening it again, please avoid hitting people nearby when lifting the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持ち上げる前に声をかけます。背負うと見えない部分があるので、手で持って乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を持上げる前に声をかけ手持ち乗車を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will let people know before lifting it. Some parts are out of sight when it is on my back, so I will carry it in my hand when boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Let people know before lifting the bag and choose to board carrying it in your hand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 扉が開いたら、乗車の案内に従ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When the doors open, please follow the boarding instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ひもが足元まで垂れていないことも確かめました。荷物を前で持ち、降りる方が通ってから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ひもと足元を確認し降車客を待って乗る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I also checked that the strap is not hanging down around my feet. I will hold the bag in front and board after people getting off have passed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the strap and the area around your feet, wait for passengers to get off, then board. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認していただき、ありがとうございます。それでは、お気をつけてお乗りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please take care as you board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 広報の求人欄についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the job advertisements in the city newsletter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この仕事に応募したいです。市の広報に載っているので、市で面接を受けるつもりで来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 市の広報掲載を市の採用と思い面接相談に来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to apply for this job. Since it is in the city newsletter, I came expecting to have an interview with the city.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook a city newsletter advertisement for city recruitment and came to ask about an interview. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 募集した団体の名前を確認しましょう。掲載元と雇用する側は同じとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the name of the recruiting organization. The publisher and the employer are not necessarily the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここには団体名が書いてありますね。市の名前だけ見て、雇用主も市だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 団体名から掲載元と雇用主が別だと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is an organization's name here. I only looked at the city's name and assumed the city was also the employer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand from the organization's name that the publisher and employer are different. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 応募先は、こちらに載っている団体の連絡先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: To apply, use the contact details for the organization listed here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。窓口で履歴書を預けず、団体へ応募方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 履歴書を市へ預けず団体に応募方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Instead of leaving my resume at this counter, I would like to ask the organization how to apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the organization how to apply instead of leaving your resume with the city. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 募集条件の質問も、掲載された応募先へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also direct questions about the employment conditions to the listed application contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 週末も働くか知りたいので、広報の写真だけで判断せず、応募先へ自分で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 週末勤務の条件を応募先へ本人が確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to know whether weekend work is required, so I will check with the application contact myself instead of judging just from the newsletter photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will personally check the weekend work conditions with the application contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 連絡先の欄をお持ち帰りになれます。ここでは採用の判断はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may take the contact details section home. We cannot make hiring decisions here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この欄を持って帰ります。市への問い合わせと団体への応募を分け、窓口に来たことを応募済みとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を持帰り問い合わせを応募完了と混同しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take this section home. I will distinguish an inquiry to the city from an application to the organization and will not consider this counter visit a completed application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the contact details home and do not confuse an inquiry with completing an application. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 応募先が確認できましたね。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have confirmed where to apply. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お名前をお呼びしましたが、何か取りに行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: We called your name. Are you going to collect something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同僚が私の上着を持っていて、中に受診のメモがあります。同僚も一緒に診察室へ来てもらうつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 上着の中の受診メモを同僚が持ち同席も考えていたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My colleague has my jacket, and my notes for the consultation are inside. I intended to have my colleague come into the examination room with me too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your colleague has your consultation notes inside your jacket and that you were also considering having them accompany you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 荷物を受け取ることと、付き添って入ることは別に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us confirm collecting your belongings separately from entering with a companion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は一人で説明できます。上着からメモを受け取ればよく、同僚に説明を代わってもらう予定はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人が説明でき荷物の受取りだけが必要と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can explain things myself. I only need to collect the notes from my jacket; I do not plan to have my colleague explain on my behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish being able to explain for yourself from only needing to collect your belongings. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでは、ここで受け取ってください。同僚の方が同席する必要がある場合は、担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please collect them here. If your colleague needs to attend with you, consult the staff member in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここへ持って来てもらいます。荷物があるだけで、同席も決まったとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同僚にメモを持参してもらい同席決定とは扱わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask them to bring them here. I will not assume that having belongings to collect means their attendance has also been approved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask your colleague to bring the notes and do not treat that as a decision that they will accompany you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: メモ以外にも、診察前に必要な物がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you need anything else before the examination besides the notes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今はありません。上着は同僚に持っていてもらい、必要なメモだけ自分で持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診察に必要なメモだけ受取り上着は預ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not at the moment. I will leave my jacket with my colleague and carry only the notes I need myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Collect only the notes needed for the examination and leave the jacket with your colleague. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取りが終わったら、こちらへお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please let us know when you have finished collecting them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモを受け取りました。同僚には待合で待ってもらい、私は自分の言葉で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メモ受領と同僚の待合待機を伝え本人が相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have received the notes. My colleague will wait in the waiting area, and I will discuss my concerns in my own words.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report receiving the notes and having your colleague wait in the waiting area, and consult for yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受取りを確認しました。それでは、診察室へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have confirmed you received them. I will now show you to the examination room. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族と連絡が取れないというご相談ですね。確認できていることを伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are here because you cannot contact a family member. Please tell me what you have confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰る予定の時刻を過ぎています。予定表では七時に家へ着くことになっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未帰宅で予定表の帰宅時刻を過ぎたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Their planned return time has passed. According to the schedule, they were supposed to arrive home at seven.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your family member has not returned and the scheduled arrival time has passed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その時刻にご本人と連絡されたということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you mean you contacted them at that time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、七時は予定です。最後に話したのは昼で、そのときは仕事場にいると言っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 七時は予定で最後の連絡は昼だったと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, seven was the planned time. I last spoke to them at noon, when they said they were at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish seven as the scheduled time from noon as the last contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 昼のお話と、帰宅予定を分けて伺います。その後の連絡はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us separate what you heard at noon from the planned return time. Have you had any contact since?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話をかけましたが出ません。電池が切れたのかもと思いますが、原因は確かめられていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話に出ず電池切れは未確認の推測だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I called, but they did not answer. I think their battery might have died, but I have not confirmed the reason.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that they are not answering and a dead battery is an unconfirmed guess. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原因が分からないこともお伝えください。最後に会った場所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also state that the reason is unknown. Where did you last see them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝、家で会いました。昼の仕事場は電話で聞いた場所で、私が見た場所ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実際に会った自宅と電話で聞いた仕事場を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: At home this morning. The workplace at noon is a location they told me over the phone, not somewhere I saw them myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish home, where you actually saw them, from the workplace mentioned over the phone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その違いを記録します。今お持ちの連絡や予定を担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will record that distinction. Please show the staff member the messages and schedule you have now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予定表と昼の連絡を分けて見せます。今も仕事場にいると決めつけず、確認できたことを順に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予定表と連絡を提示し現在地を推測で断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the schedule and the noon communication separately. I will not assume they are still at work; I will explain the confirmed facts in order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present the schedule and communications without asserting their current location based on a guess. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご説明ありがとうございます。担当へおつなぎします。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for explaining. I will connect you with the staff member in charge. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 宛名の文字が少し薄いようです。確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The address looks a little faint. Could you check it, please?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 間違えないよう鉛筆で下書きしました。正しい宛先の写真を携帯で見せれば、このままでも伝わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薄い鉛筆下書きと携帯宛先写真で送れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I drafted it in pencil to avoid mistakes. If I show you a photo of the correct address on my phone, will it be understood as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can mail it with a faint pencil draft and a photo of the address on your phone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 携帯の写真と、郵便物に書かれた宛先は別です。現物で読めるように整えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The photo on your phone and the address written on the mail are separate. Let us make the address readable on the actual item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真は私が書くための確認用なのですね。配送先へ写真も一緒に送られると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真が本人の記入確認用で現物の代わりでないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the photo is for me to check while writing. I thought the photo would be sent to the delivery destination too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that the photo helps you check your writing and does not replace the actual address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付で見せた写真が宛名の代わりになるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: A photo shown at the counter does not serve as a substitute for the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この封筒を読みやすく書き直します。急いで今出すより、一文字ずつ写真と照らし合わせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 急がず写真と照合して現物を書き直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will rewrite this envelope legibly. Instead of rushing to send it now, I want to compare it with the photo one character at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will take your time, compare it with the photo, and rewrite the actual item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書き直した後、送る物そのものをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: After rewriting it, check the actual item you are sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。写真の字だけ読んで、封筒にも同じ字が書けたと思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 参考写真の読み取りと封筒への記入結果を別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will avoid assuming I wrote the same characters on the envelope just because I can read them in the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check reading the reference photo separately from the result written on the envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの記入場所をご利用いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may use this writing area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記入場所で仕上げます。写真を閉じてから封筒だけを見て、読めるかもう一度確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記入後写真を閉じ封筒単体の読みやすさを点検する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will finish it in the writing area. Then I will close the photo and look only at the envelope to check again that it is readable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After writing, close the photo and check the envelope's readability on its own. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 仕上がりましたら受付へお持ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring it to the counter when it is ready. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 筆談でのご相談は、ここまででよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Does that conclude your consultation by writing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、説明を読み取れました。このボードに書いた家族の話は、残したまま返すのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 筆談完了後ボードの私的な記載を残して返すか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I understood the written explanation. Should I return this board with the personal family matters I wrote still on it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: After finishing the written consultation, ask whether to return the board with private information still on it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 共有するボードですので、内容が残らないようにして回収します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is a shared board, so we collect it after ensuring no content remains.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の紙のように持ち帰る物ではないのですね。記録したい説明だけ、自分のメモに移してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 共有備品と理解し必要説明を本人のメモへ移す許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is not something I take home like my own paper. May I copy just the explanation I want to keep into my own notes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that it is shared equipment and ask permission to copy the necessary explanation into your own notes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。口座情報なども含め、周囲に見えないようにご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do. Check it out of others' view, including any account information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 必要な説明を自分のメモに写しました。家族の事情は写さず、ボードには残さないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要説明のみ写し家族事情のボード消去を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I copied the necessary explanation into my notes. I did not copy my family circumstances; please make sure they do not remain on the board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Copy only the necessary explanation and ask for the family information to be erased from the board. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容を消します。画面全体が空白になったことをご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will erase the content. Please check that the entire screen is blank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 空白になりました。小さい文字が端に残っていないことも確かめました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全体と端の文字が消えたことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is blank. I also checked that no small writing remains along the edges.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the writing across the whole board and along the edges has been erased. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ボードはこちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. We will take the board back here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返します。自分のメモはかばんへしまい、次の方に内容が見える状態で席を離れないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ボードを返却し本人のメモをしまって席を離れる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here it is. I will put my notes in my bag and avoid leaving my seat with the contents visible to the next person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the board, put your own notes away, and then leave your seat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございました。本日のご相談は以上です。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. That concludes today's consultation. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カートをそこで止めていらっしゃいますが、何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have stopped your cart there. Has something happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 床が濡れていました。誰かが踏まないようにと思って、カートで囲おうとしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 濡れた床をカートで囲おうとしたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The floor was wet. I tried to surround it with carts so nobody would step on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you tried to surround the wet floor with carts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: カートで通路を塞ぐ前に、店員へお知らせください。濡れている場所を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell a staff member before blocking the aisle with carts. Could you show me where it is wet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この棚の前です。ただ、カートの車輪が水の上を通って、細い跡がこちらまで付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元の濡れた範囲と自分の車輪で延びた跡を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: In front of this shelf. But my cart's wheels went through the water and left a thin trail as far as here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the originally wet area from the trail extended by your own cart's wheels. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見つけた場所と、車輪の跡を分けて確認します。ご自身で拭こうとされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the place you found separately from the wheel tracks. Did you try to wipe it up yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 拭いていません。原因も見ていないので、この棚の商品がこぼれたとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 拭いておらず商品が原因かも未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not wiped it. I did not see the cause either, so I cannot say something from this shelf spilled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not wiped it and have not confirmed whether a product caused it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで対応します。カートを広げず、いまの位置で少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will handle it. Please do not spread the carts out; wait a moment where you are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待ちます。ほかの客に商品が破損したと話すのではなく、濡れた床があるとだけ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カートを広げず待ち他客へ未確認の破損を断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait. Instead of telling other customers a product broke, I will only tell them there is a wet patch on the floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait without spreading the carts out and do not tell other customers that unconfirmed product damage is a fact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。カートは案内した乾いた側へ移していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have checked it. You may move your cart to the dry side indicated.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その側へ移します。最初の水と車輪で延びた跡を伝えられたので、清掃はお任せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 職員の示す乾いた側へ移り清掃を引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will move to that side. I have explained the original water and the trail left by the wheels, so I will leave the cleaning to you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Move to the dry side indicated by staff and hand over the cleaning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせいただき、ありがとうございました。それでは、足元にお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Please watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その写真を撮るために、奥まで入られたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you go all the way in there to take that photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いえ、通路から撮りました。友人にも見てほしくて、この鳥がいる場所への行き方を投稿に書いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通路から撮った鳥の写真と詳しい場所を投稿予定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: No, I took it from the path. I want my friends to see it too, so I am writing directions to this bird's location in my post.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you plan to post a bird photo taken from the path along with its detailed location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見つけた場所へ人を案内する前に、観察の注意事項をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before directing people to where you found it, please check the observation guidelines.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 注意の掲示に、鳥を追いかけないとあります。詳しい場所を書けば、みんなが探しに来るかもしれませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 位置公開で人が鳥を探しに来る可能性に気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The notice says not to chase birds. If I write the exact location, everyone might come looking for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Recognize that revealing the location could bring people looking for the bird. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 鳥は通路から静かにご覧ください。茂みに入って探すような案内はお控えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please watch birds quietly from the path. Refrain from giving directions that encourage people to enter the bushes to look for them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 投稿から曲がり角と茂みの位置を外します。通路から撮った写真だけを、場所を詳しく示さずに載せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曲がり角と茂み位置を外し写真だけの投稿へ変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will remove the turning point and the location of the bushes from my post. I would like to post just the photo taken from the path without showing the precise location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Remove the turning point and bush location and change the post to just the photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 観察を続ける場合も、声や音で鳥を呼び寄せないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even if you continue observing, do not attract birds with voices or sounds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鳴き声を携帯で再生して呼ぶのはやめます。見えなくなったら、そのまま散歩に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鳴声で呼寄せず見えなくなれば散歩へ戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will stop playing bird calls on my phone to attract it. If it goes out of sight, I will simply return to my walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide not to attract it with bird calls and to resume your walk if it disappears from view. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの方にも、自然に見えた範囲で楽しむようお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell others to enjoy what they can see naturally too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人には静かに通路から見ることを伝えます。同じ写真を撮るために茂みへ集まる約束はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人へ静かな通路観察を伝え撮影目的の集合を約束しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell my friends to watch quietly from the path. I will not arrange to gather in the bushes to take the same photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell friends to observe quietly from the path and do not arrange a gathering for photography. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご配慮ありがとうございます。それでは、静かに公園をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your consideration. Please enjoy the park quietly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内板を移動しますので、こちらを少し空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: We are moving the signboard, so please clear a little space here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 重そうですね。私が反対側を持てば、早く運べると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職員の案内板運搬を手伝いたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It looks heavy. I think it would be quicker to carry if I held the opposite side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Offer to help staff carry the signboard. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございますが、移動は職員で行います。急に持ち上げないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you, but staff will move it. Please do not suddenly lift it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ触っていません。手伝うつもりでも、勝手に持つと職員の方の動きが変わってしまいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触で勝手な持上げが相手の作業に影響すると理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not touched it yet. Even if I mean to help, picking it up without asking would affect how the staff move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not touched it and understand that lifting it without permission affects the other person's work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。お客様は、通行の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please wait for directions on where to pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらで待ちます。板を避けるため、作業する方の後ろをすり抜けてよいかも、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待機を了承し作業者の後ろを通れるか先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait here. I also want to ask first whether I may slip behind the people working to get around the board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Agree to wait and ask first whether you can pass behind the workers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は後ろを通らず、私の示した側でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not pass behind us now; please wait on the side I indicated.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その側にいます。別の客が来ても、私が勝手に通ってよいと案内しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 職員の指定側で待ち他客へ通行許可を出さない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will stay on that side. Even if another customer comes, I will not tell them they can pass without authorization.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait on the side designated by staff and do not give other customers permission to pass. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 移動が終わりました。こちらの通路をお通りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have finished moving it. You may use this passage now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 終わったことを確認して進みます。手伝いを申し出ることと、実際に作業へ入ることを分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 移動完了後に進み申出と作業参加を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm it is finished before proceeding. I will distinguish offering help from actually joining the work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Proceed after the move is complete and distinguish offering from participating in the work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Take care.
